SELECT TT.PQD_NO, TT.PQD_FAREN, TT.PQD_CHENGSHIDENGJI, TT.PQD_SHENGFEN, TT.PQD_CHENGSHIMINGCHENG, TT.PQD_DIQUMINGCHENG, TT.ACTIVITY, TT.PQD_DAORU_RESULT, TT.PQD_001 CHECK_ERROR FROM SY_DISPATCH_TEMP TT WHERE TT.CREATED_BY = #CREATED_BY# ORDER BY TT.PQD_NO

ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #PQD_NO#, #PQD_FAREN#, #PQD_CHENGSHIDENGJI#, #PQD_SHENGFEN#, #PQD_CHENGSHIMINGCHENG#, #PQD_DIQUMINGCHENG#,
